title: The Ordinary Jackpot
description: The Ordinary Jackpot is an ongoing South Korean workplace television series written and directed by Yoon Young-bin, and starring Lee Joon-hyuk, Seo Hyun-woo, and Oh Dae-hwan. Based on the web novel of the same name by Seo In-ha, the series follows a salaryman who continues his corporate life with a newfound sense of psychological security and boldness after winning the lottery jackpot. It premiered on TVING on September 10, 2026, at 18:00 (KST) and will also broadcast on tvN on September 14, airing every Monday and Tuesday at 21:00 (KST).
